data.narrative:
Skydio, a Series F autonomous systems company in Defense & Security, carries a current post-money valuation of $4.4B following $825M+ in total capital raised. Valuation triangulation draws on a comparable universe of 10 peers—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private entities spanning similar sector and valuation tier. Relevant private comparables include Shield AI ($12.7B, Series G), Helsing ($18.0B, Series D), and Saronic ($9.2B, Series D).

Two quantitative methods anchor the analysis. Stage-progression applies a standard 1.3x step-up multiplier from the $4.4B Series F post-money, yielding $5.7B. Peer-median analysis across 17 same-sector, similar-tier companies produces a $2.2B implied value, with the peer set ranging from $1.0B to $18.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects heterogeneous financing and growth profiles within Defense & Security.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $1.9B to $6.6B, with a median of $4.0B. This median approximates the current $4.4B valuation. Key uncertainties include revenue scale and growth trajectory relative to peers, market timing for defense procurement cycles, and the stage-appropriate exit multiple in this sector. The peer-median method's low output warrants scrutiny; several top comparables command substantially higher valuations, suggesting either Skydio's positioning or market timing may warrant valuation toward the upper half of the derived range.
